thread:
marta: quick: CI vitest edge job failed after ESM-only SDK push. Error: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prototype')` when stubbing client.

dan: node version on CI?

marta: node18 image. local dev node20 ok.

olga: classic ESM/CJS mismatch. Are tests doing `vi.mock('sdk', () => ({ Client: Mock }))`?

marta: yes. old tests assumed CJS interop (require(...).default). New bundle is pure ESM.

dan: two easy fixes: update tests to use `vi.stubModule`/async `vi.mock` with `vi.importActual`, or add test-only CJS shim.

marta: can you paste the async pattern?

dan: `vi.mock('sdk', async () => { const real = await vi.importActual('sdk'); return { default: { ...real.default, request: () => 'x' } } })`

olga: also set vitest.config `deps.inline` for any CJS deps that cause `exports is not defined`, and `esbuild.platform='node'` so builtins like `node:buffer` aren't stripped.

ci-bot: nightly run 1780000000: vitest edge failed 2/2 on node18. Logs: /artifacts/1780000000-vitest.log

marta: typings broke too: `Property 'createClient' does not exist` — our .d.ts still `export =` style.

olga: change root d.ts to expose both default and named:

`declare class Client { constructor(opts?: any); }
declare const _default: Client;
export default _default;
export { Client };`

marta: quick workaround added: `test/helpers/compat.cjs`:
`(async ()=>{ const m = await import('../dist/index.mjs'); module.exports = m.default ?? m; })()`

dan: works for CJS consumers; for vitest ESM tests prefer importing shim.mjs that re-exports named exports.

marta: going to add docs: vitest config snippet, mock examples, shim recipes, d.ts pattern, and CI suggestion (add node20 or build:test:cjs). Will open PR.

olga: +1. Also recommend adding a tiny CI job that runs the edge runner against the built ESM bundle to catch this earlier.

qa-bot: note recorded: ticket DEVEX-312: ESM interop flakiness in tests.

marta: thanks all — will ping when PR is ready. :sparkles:
